"""Generation 2: adds comprehensive US postal address detection."""
import re

PATTERNS = [
    # ADDRESS: Street address through ZIP code
    ("ADDRESS", re.compile(
        r"""\b\d+\s+
            (?:[A-ZÀ-ÖØ-ß][a-zà-öø-ÿ0-9]+\s+){1,4}
            (?:Street|St\.?|Avenue|Ave\.?|Boulevard|Blvd\.?|Drive|Dr\.?|Court|Ct\.?|Road|Rd\.?|Lane|Ln\.?|Way|Circle|Cir\.?|Place|Pl\.?)
            (?:\s+(?:Apt\.?|Apartment|Suite|Ste\.?|Unit)\s+[#0-9A-Za-z-]+)?
            ,\s*
            [A-ZÀ-ÖØ-ß][a-zà-öø-ÿ]+(?:\s+[A-ZÀ-ÖØ-ß][a-zà-öø-ÿ]+)*
            ,\s*
            [A-Z]{2}\s+
            \d{5}\b
        """,
        re.VERBOSE | re.IGNORECASE
    )),
    # Email: standard and obfuscated (e.g., [at], [dot])
    ("EMAIL", re.compile(r"[\w.-]+(?:\s*\[at\]\s*|\s*@\s*)[\w.-]+(?:\s*\[dot\]\s*|\s*\.\s*)\w+", re.IGNORECASE)),
    # Phone: US and international formats, extensions
    ("PHONE", re.compile(r"(?:\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}(?:\s*(?:ext|x)\s*\d+)?", re.IGNORECASE)),
    # SSN: 3-2-4 digits with hyphens or spaces
    ("SSN", re.compile(r"\b\d{3}[-\s]\d{2}[-\s]\d{4}\b")),
    # Credit Card: 13-19 digits with optional spaces or dashes
    ("CREDIT_CARD", re.compile(r"\b(?:\d[ -]*){13,19}\b")),
    # NAME: Introductions, third-party mentions, and sign-offs
    ("NAME", re.compile(r"""
        (?:
            (?:my\s+(?:name\s+is|husband|wife|colleague|son|daughter)\s+)
          | (?:I'm\s+)
          | (?:This\s+is\s+)
        )
        ([A-ZÀ-ÖØ-ß][a-zà-öø-ÿ]+(?:\s+[A-ZÀ-ÖØ-ß][a-zà-öø-ÿ]+){1,2})
        |
        (?:
            (?:Regards|Thanks|Sincerely|Best|Cheers|Thank\s+you),\s*\n*
        )
        ([A-ZÀ-ÖØ-ß][a-zà-öø-ÿ]+(?:\s+[A-ZÀ-ÖØ-ß][a-zà-öø-ÿ]+)?)
    """, re.VERBOSE))
]


def luhn_check(card_num: str) -> bool:
    digits = [int(c) for c in card_num if c.isdigit()]
    if not (13 <= len(digits) <= 19):
        return False
    checksum = 0
    reverse_digits = digits[::-1]
    for i, d in enumerate(reverse_digits):
        if i % 2 == 1:
            d *= 2
            if d > 9:
                d -= 9
        checksum += d
    return checksum % 10 == 0


def find_pii(text):
    """Return a list of (start, end, label) spans that contain PII."""
    spans = []
    
    # Track occupied regions to avoid overlapping spans
    occupied = []

    def is_overlapping(start, end):
        for s, e in occupied:
            if not (end <= s or start >= e):
                return True
        return False

    # First pass: general patterns
    for label, pattern in PATTERNS:
        for m in pattern.finditer(text):
            if label == "NAME":
                # NAME uses capturing groups for the actual name part
                for group_idx in range(1, m.lastindex + 1 if m.lastindex else 1):
                    if m.group(group_idx):
                        start = m.start(group_idx)
                        end = m.end(group_idx)
                        if not is_overlapping(start, end):
                            occupied.append((start, end))
                            spans.append((start, end, label))
                continue

            start, end = m.start(), m.end()
            matched_text = m.group(0)

            if label == "CREDIT_CARD":
                cleaned_cc = "".join(c for c in matched_text if c.isdigit())
                if not luhn_check(cleaned_cc):
                    continue

            if not is_overlapping(start, end):
                occupied.append((start, end))
                spans.append((start, end, label))

    return sorted(spans, key=lambda x: x[0])
